short: Child repos without a merge path: extend the degen/home exception how far?
title: q_max, banchi, mailaudit, ios-adblock and joyous have no merge path, so CI-speed lanes there cannot start. Extend your 22:13 CST degen-and-home exception to q_max first and the rest one at a time (a), wait for a batch tool in each repo (b), or all five now (c)?
why: Your 22:13 CST ruling covers degen and home only. In the other five repos a PR cannot merge, so a CI-speed lane there has no path and your 20:41 CST rule (no path, no spawn) holds it.
